patterns.message: Import Pi Durable, pi-ai, pi-schema, and chord through src/agent/pi/ (durable.ts, shared.ts, …) so an upgrade is fixed in one folder.

Only the Telegram door reads or writes its documents (COD-210). Core reaches its inputs and chats through the door's registrations (src/doors/telegram/index.ts); the composition root may name the door's runtime and sender.
Import Pi Durable, pi-ai, pi-schema, and chord through src/agent/pi/ (durable.ts, shared.ts, …) so an upgrade is fixed in one folder.
Core imports no door, extension or tool (COD-208, COD-210): only the composition root (agent-do.ts, composition.ts) names them. Reach a feature through a connector.
